layouts.name: CResource_Proxy
layouts.notes: On build 17763, CResource::Create allocates 32 bytes and writes the vtable at +0, reference count at +8, IDwmChannel* at +16, and resource handle at +24. CResource::Initialize and WrapExistingResource write the same +16/+24 pair, while CResource::~CResource independently consumes it. The CResource object therefore exposes the proxy view itself before build 18362, so offset 0 is its address rather than a pointer field. Starting with build 18362, offset 2 * sizeof(PVOID) stores a CResourceProxy pointer. CResource::GetProxy must branch before interpreting this storage; reading the pre-18362 offset 0 as CResourceProxy* instead reads the object's vtable pointer.

layouts.notes: CAtlasedRectsVisual::InsertAtlasImageAtIndex writes the owning CAtlasedRectsVisual pointer to CAtlasedImage +80 and RemoveAtlasImage clears it; CButton::RedrawVisual reads the same link while moving atlas images. Verified on uDWM 22000.194, 22621.6630, and 26100.7705. On 26100.7705, DisconnectFromParent reads +80, InsertAtlasImageAtIndex writes +80, and CButton::RedrawVisual routes movement through DisconnectFromParent and AddAtlasImage. notes: Reverse-engineering guidance migrated verbatim from the pre-codegen offset table:

============================================================================
uDWM Offset Stability Rules
============================================================================
uDWM.dll is NOT recompiled for every Windows build. Offsets only change at
recompile boundaries (codebase generations):

  17763 — Windows 10 1809 (minimum supported)
  18362 — Windows 10 1903, 1909
  19041 — Windows 10 2004, 20H2, 21H1, 21H2, 22H2
  20348 — Windows Server 2022
  22000 — Windows 11 21H2 RTM (Build 22000)
  22621 — Windows 11 22H2, 23H2
  26100 — Windows 11 24H2, 25H2
  28000 — Windows 11 26H1+ (MIL infrastructure removed)

Feature gates:
  GetSystemBackdropType → 21H2+
  GetDWriteTextVisual_Index → 22H2+ (appears with CDWriteText)
  _OnLegacy variants → 22H2+ (CLegacyNonClientBackground introduced)
  CWindowBorder / GetWindowBorder_Index → 21H2+ (NOT 22H2+)
  CAnimatedGlassSheet → pre-21H2; replaced by CAcrylicSheet in 21H2+

Interval semantics: until<BUILD, REVISION>() supplies an exclusive RIGHT
boundary. otherwise() is the explicit open-ended fallback. If otherwise()
is absent, later versions are unsupported.
============================================================================
This schema is the editable source of truth; generated headers must preserve these notes.
